events.title: The Prophet's Final Revelation
events.description: Your prophet emerges from meditation with blazing eyes. 'I have seen the truth — our faith shall reshape the world, but only if we act NOW.'

events.title: The Prophet's Trial
events.description: Your prophet retreats into the wilderness for 40 days. Followers grow anxious. Some begin to doubt.

choices.text: Send disciples to watch over them
Let them face the trial alone

events.title: The Prophet's Vision
events.description: Your spiritual leader claims to have received a divine vision during prayer. The faithful are stirred.

choices.text: Keep it secret among the inner circle
Dismiss it as a fever dream

events.title: The Scholar's Legacy
events.description: The scholar's writings have spread far. They challenge core tenets but also attract intellectuals to your faith.

events.title: The Scholar's Debate
events.description: The scholar challenges your high priest to a public theological debate. The crowd gathers.

events.title: The Heretic Scholar
events.description: A brilliant but controversial scholar has begun teaching alternative interpretations of your sacred texts.

events.title: Plague's End
events.description: The plague has finally subsided. Survivors look to your faith for meaning in their suffering.

events.title: The Plague Spreads
events.description: The disease has reached multiple cities. Panic grips the population. Many turn to faith for salvation.

events.title: Plague Response
events.description: Your advisors urge immediate action. The sick are multiplying.

events.title: The Great Plague
events.description: A terrible disease has broken out in one of the cities. People are dying by the dozens. They cry out for help.

events.title: The Relic's Power
events.description: Pilgrims flock to see the relic. Miracles are reported. Your faith's influence grows tremendously.

events.title: Authenticating the Relic
events.description: Scholars examine the relic. Some claim it's genuine, others say it's a forgery. The debate could shake faith.

choices.text: Declare it authentic by divine authority

events.title: Discovery of a Holy Relic
events.description: Excavators have unearthed what appears to be an ancient artifact of immense spiritual significance.

events.title: Rival Faith Resolution
events.description: The confrontation with the rival faith reaches a critical point. Your followers demand decisive action.

events.title: The Rival Grows Bold
events.description: The rival faith has gained a significant following. Their priests openly challenge your authority in the streets.

choices.text: Challenge them to a theological contest

events.title: A Rival Faith Emerges
events.description: A charismatic preacher has begun spreading a competing religion. They claim divine revelation of their own.

events.title: The Kingdom Transforms
events.description: The converted kingdom has fully embraced your faith. Their armies now fly your banners alongside their own.

events.title: Royal Baptism
events.description: The king's conversion ceremony is a grand affair. Nobles are divided — some follow willingly, others seethe.

events.title: A King Considers Conversion
events.description: The ruler of a powerful kingdom has expressed interest in converting to your faith. This could change everything.

events.title: The Canon Established
events.description: The sacred text is complete. It becomes the foundation of your faith's teaching for generations to come.

choices.text: Keep it for the clergy only

events.title: The Scribes' Debate
events.description: Different scribes have produced varying versions of the text. Which interpretation becomes canon?

events.title: Writing the Sacred Text
events.description: Your scholars propose codifying your faith's teachings into a definitive holy book.

events.title: The Martyr's Legacy
events.description: Stories of the martyr spread like wildfire. Converts flock to your banner. But some question if the sacrifice was necessary.

events.title: A Faithful Martyr
events.description: One of your devoted followers has been executed by a hostile kingdom for refusing to renounce the faith.

events.title: The Grand Temple Complete
events.description: The temple stands as the greatest monument to your faith. Pilgrims come from across the world to marvel at it.

choices.text: Declare it the center of the faith
Dedicate it to all seekers of truth

events.title: Temple Construction Troubles
events.description: The temple project faces setbacks. Workers demand more pay, and the design is more ambitious than expected.

events.title: The Grand Temple Project
events.description: Your architects propose building a magnificent temple that would be the wonder of the world.

events.title: Inquisition Aftermath
events.description: The inquisition has ended. Order is restored, but at what cost? The faithful are divided.

events.title: The Inquisition Intensifies
events.description: Your inquisitors have uncovered a vast network of heresy. Hundreds stand accused. The people tremble.

events.title: Call for Inquisition
events.description: Heresy festers in your domain. Your advisors recommend establishing a formal inquisition to root out false beliefs.

events.title: Trade Route Established
events.description: The merchant network is thriving. Gold flows and your faith travels with every caravan.

events.title: The Merchant's Offer
events.description: A wealthy merchant guild offers to fund your faith's expansion in exchange for favorable trade rights.

events.title: Pilgrimage Season
events.description: Faithful from across the land embark on pilgrimage. The roads are filled with the devoted.

events.title: A Child Prodigy
events.description: A young child displays remarkable spiritual gifts, speaking of visions and performing apparent miracles.

events.title: Temple Vandalism
events.description: Unknown assailants have desecrated one of your temples. The faithful are outraged.

events.title: Mystical Phenomenon
events.description: Strange lights appear over a holy site. Crowds gather, interpreting it as a divine sign.

events.title: Schismatic Preacher
events.description: A popular preacher begins teaching doctrines that differ from official canon.

events.title: Noble Conversion
events.description: A prominent noble has converted to your faith, bringing many followers.

events.title: Royal Wedding
events.description: A royal marriage between two kingdoms is planned. They seek your faith's blessing.

events.title: Border Dispute
events.description: Two kingdoms quarrel over territory. Both sides appeal to your faith for mediation.

events.title: Tax Revolt
events.description: Peasants in a faithful region revolt against heavy taxes. They invoke your teachings of charity.

events.title: Diplomatic Mission
events.description: A foreign kingdom sends envoys seeking to learn about your faith.

events.title: Warrior Monks
events.description: Devout warriors seek to form a holy military order dedicated to defending the faith.

events.title: War Refugees
events.description: Refugees from a nearby conflict flood into faithful cities, straining resources.

events.title: Mercenary Offer
events.description: A band of mercenaries offers their swords in service of your faith — for a price.

events.title: Victory Celebration
events.description: Your forces have won a significant battle. The faithful rejoice.

events.title: Fortress of Faith
events.description: Engineers propose building a great fortress to protect a holy site.

events.title: Bountiful Harvest
events.description: The harvest this year is exceptionally abundant. Farmers praise your faith's blessings.

events.title: Famine
events.description: Crops have failed across the region. People are starving and desperate.

events.title: Gold Mine Discovered
events.description: A rich gold mine has been found in territory controlled by the faithful.

events.title: Trade Disruption
events.description: Bandits have been attacking trade caravans, disrupting commerce.

events.title: Wealthy Benefactor
events.description: An incredibly wealthy patron wishes to donate to your faith.

events.title: Sacred Music
events.description: Composers have created beautiful hymns that move all who hear them.

events.title: Ancient Ruins
events.description: Explorers discover ruins of an ancient civilization with mysterious inscriptions.

choices.text: Claim them as proof of your faith's antiquity

events.title: Festival of Lights
events.description: The faithful wish to establish an annual festival celebrating illumination and truth.

events.title: Foreign Philosophy
events.description: Scholars bring knowledge of foreign philosophies that could enrich or challenge your faith.

events.title: Artistic Renaissance
events.description: A wave of artistic creativity sweeps through faithful communities.

events.title: Earthquake
events.description: A powerful earthquake devastates several cities. The faithful look to you for guidance.

events.title: Flood
events.description: Severe flooding destroys homes and farmland. Many are left homeless.

events.title: Eclipse
events.description: A solar eclipse terrifies the population. Superstition runs rampant.

events.title: Drought
events.description: A prolonged drought threatens agriculture and water supplies.

events.title: Locust Swarm
events.description: A massive swarm of locusts devours crops across multiple regions.

events.title: Corruption Scandal
events.description: High-ranking clergy members are found to be embezzling faith funds.

events.title: Succession Crisis
events.description: The head of a major temple has died without naming a successor.

events.title: Theological Dispute
events.description: Scholars disagree on a fundamental point of doctrine. The debate grows heated.

events.title: Youth Movement
events.description: Young believers are pushing for reform and modernization of the faith.

events.title: Monastic Order
events.description: Devout followers wish to establish a contemplative monastic order.

choices.text: The faith is lived in the world

events.title: Strange Omen
events.description: A two-headed calf is born in a faithful village. The people see it as an omen.

events.title: Printing Revolution
events.description: A new method of copying texts quickly has been developed.

events.title: Holy Spring Discovered
events.description: A spring with seemingly healing waters has been found.

events.title: Ambassador's Gift
events.description: A foreign ruler sends lavish gifts seeking your faith's favor.

choices.text: Return them — we cannot be bought

events.title: Cemetery Miracle
events.description: A faithful follower reportedly rose from the dead, then died again peacefully.

events.title: Starving Beggars
events.description: Masses of starving beggars gather outside your temples seeking aid.

events.title: Secret Society
events.description: Reports indicate a secret society working against your faith from within.

events.title: Miracle Healer
events.description: A person claiming to heal through faith alone draws massive crowds.

events.title: Astronomical Discovery
events.description: Scholars make a remarkable discovery about the stars.

events.title: Foreign Missionary
events.description: Missionaries from a distant land arrive preaching a strange faith.

events.title: Ancient Prophecy
events.description: An ancient prophecy is discovered that seems to predict your faith's rise.

events.title: Mass Baptism
events.description: Thousands wish to be baptized into your faith at once.

events.title: Heretical Book
events.description: A book criticizing your faith becomes wildly popular.

events.title: Peace Conference
events.description: Multiple kingdoms propose a peace conference, seeking your faith's moral authority to broker it.

events.title: Volcanic Eruption
events.description: A distant volcano erupts, sending ash clouds across the sky. People are terrified.

events.description: A ancient prophecy brings hope across the land. Your response will shape the faith's future.

events.description: A eternal dawn strengthens belief across the land. Your response will shape the faith's future.
